title: Biryulki Op. 2 - No. 5
notable_excerpt: Key: B major. Chord journey: v - i - iii - i rocking, vi - i54 - ii42 detour, closes hovering on ii42 over a B pedal. Texture: Vivace; quarter-note chords with eighth-note bass figuration.
